name: Report to Jennea
label: Quest
description: Report to Jennea: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your knowledge of the craft grows, young friend. Are you now ready to begin your true lessons? Are you ready to take your place in the secret war we wage?
If so, then speak with Jennea Cannon, in the wizard's sanctum in the mage district of Stormwind. She has a task for you which will open your first window into the invisible world.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend, I have a mission for you, here in the mage district. Listen closely, for there is no time to waste.
